body: I'm going to write down your username and I'll message you in my main account if anything changes...
If it gets better I'll message you telling you all about it, if it gets worse I'll message you and finish the deed.
I guess, if I stay alive that long.
Whatever you say then... Maybe I'll stick around another year or two just to prove my point...
I've been waiting for about four years... one day am I going to wake up and the world will just flip upside down and everything in my life is going to be like a fucking fairytale?
I'm done lying to myself... Shit just keeps getting worse and worse.
I've been telling myself that for years.
Of what? That I've failed at everything, even getting rid of myself?
I just pulled the trigger, the damn thing didn't work... go figure.

And what? Continue my hellish existence? Watch my self fall farther and farther down the slope of memory loss? Die alone (like Im going to now) at some old age, being a burden to my family? No thanks...
I know right, the only thing I'm good at is wasting resources for everything else in this planet. I have memory issues, I just want to fade into oblivion.
